summary: Thin wrapper that calls VTableBoolCheck(a1, 140, &a1) and returns true only when the vtable-dispatched boolean test yields zero (negated boolean result).

local_names.a1: argument forwarded to VTableBoolCheck and also passed by address as the third argument

operations.description: Calls VTableBoolCheck(a1, 140, &a1), a vtable-dispatched boolean test with selector literal 140 and a pointer to the local argument copy as the third argument.
Compares the VTableBoolCheck result against 0, inverting the boolean.
Returns true when VTableBoolCheck returned zero, otherwise false.

unresolved: Meaning of the selector literal 140 and of the third pointer argument (&a1) passed to VTableBoolCheck is unknown; caller context (NetComm_SetSelfAsReady, ConditionalRenderStateUpdate) suggests a readiness or state query, but this is not evidenced.
